tagline: I like figuring things out — and I like sharing what I figure out even more.
introStatement: Between music, tutoring, and helping out in the library, most of what I do outside class comes back to the same thing: taking something I've learned and passing it on.
aboutParagraphs: I love music, but what I enjoy most is sharing it. During Multicultural Week, I turned that into an International Music Trivia Challenge — picking songs from around the world and getting a room full of people trying to place each one.

Outside of music, I like being useful in small, practical ways — helping people find their next book as a library monitor, tutoring students who want extra support, and pulling coffees at the church café on weekends to help fundraise.
